source_caption_text:
Yachty really could not let this go 😭

Lil Yachty went viral after genuinely questioning the design of a vending machine. He noticed that a glass bottle was sitting on the highest row and immediately started wondering what would happen when someone bought it. His concern was simple: if the machine dropped the bottle from that height, wouldn’t it just smash when it hit the bottom?

What started as a random observation quickly turned into a full internet debate. Fans began discussing whether the bottle was actually strong enough to survive the drop, while others questioned why the machine was designed that way in the first place. Yachty’s genuine curiosity made the whole situation even funnier because he was clearly taking the vending machine physics very seriously.

Eventually, Yachty decided there was only one way to settle the debate. He bought the exact drink he had been worried about and watched as the bottle dropped through the machine. Somehow, it survived the fall completely intact, proving that his concern had been unnecessary all along. What began as Yachty questioning a vending machine turned into one of the most unexpectedly entertaining internet moments.
